msg: There seem to be four gnome colours.  For me the purple and dark red/maroon coloured gnomes seem to produce higher numbers of mushrooms.  Select these colours but when the mushroom values start to be consistently low, move on to the light green and light brown gnomes for a short time of about 4 selections then move back to selecting the purple and dark red/maroon gnomes.I also pressed to select the gnome as quickly as possible and then started repeatedly hitting the space bar when moving to the forest.  I have no way of telling for sure but it seemed to maintain a high value of mushrooms when i did this.
